title: 2 AL/BC UI patterns: client-expression in-list (AL0573) and Role Center AccessByPermission
summary: Two new UI knowledge articles were added. One covers in-list set-membership tests in client expressions such as Visible or Enabled on actions, groups and parts, which only raise warning AL0573. The other covers using AccessByPermission for permission gating on Role Centers, where triggers and procedures are not allowed.
key_points: In-list tests in Enabled/Visible/Editable/StyleExpr are an error on fields (AL0322) but only warning AL0573 on actions, groups and parts
Remediation: an or-chain, or a global Boolean recomputed in OnAfterGetCurrRecord and OnValidate; plain comparisons stay valid
Role Centers cannot have triggers (AL0378) or procedures (AL0569), so AccessByPermission on parts, actions and fields is the declarative fix for permission gating
AccessByPermission removes UI elements and is not a security boundary; setup or feature-flag gating is out of scope
al-ui-review.md gains tokens and mappings, and both articles are registered in review-fixtures.json
quote: AL0573, a warning that will become an error in a future release, so it builds and ships.
